A Cargo Pad is a launch pad with a hold. Build a 3x3 pad around it, pipe fuel and items in, and place a second one where the goods should land.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.cargo_rock: A Cargo Rocket needs no pilot. Deploy it on a Cargo Pad, pick the destination pad in the GUI and press Launch — or let the schedule do it.
gui.nerospace.star_guide.step.first_frei: Your first delivery arrives on the far pad with nobody at either end. Pipes take it from there. Flights survive a server restart.
